title: Volume 2 Chapter 3: Typhoon Day Fever
content: "I've come."
On a dim Friday morning in September.
With a storm expected in the afternoon due to the typhoon, Tendou Tsukasa, who had arrived ahead of the storm, wore a mischievous smile on her impressively beautiful face.
"Hey, Iori-kun, why do you have such a weird expression? Your cute girlfriend just came to play in your room."
Well, of course, I'm happy about that.
But I was just wondering why Tsukasa-san is here when classes are canceled because of the typhoon.
Isn't that a bit dangerous?
The storm wouldn't hit for a little while longer, but this typhoon was predicted to be quite powerful.
"Oh, is that so? I didn't notice at all. I was thinking we could go to school together, but that's too bad."
"Is that even possible??"
"I thought it was strange since there were so few people on the train and at the station."
"I've never heard such a blatant excuse before..."
She was being way too obvious about her intentions.
After all, due to the frequent heavy rains in recent years, the announcement for a full cancellation of classes had been made early yesterday morning.
Moreover, Tendou always checks our plans whenever classes are canceled, so there's no way she wouldn't know about it.
This meant it was a deliberate act.
Q.E.D., proof complete.
"But it's going to be tough to go back now, so you're going to let me stay over, right?"
Tendou's expression, which showed no signs of concern, only strengthened my conviction.
"Your bag is clearly huge."
"Well, the trains might stop running, you know."
"No way, that's not going to happen."
After all, the subway she uses for commuting is the strongest line that shines with the words
"normal operation,
" even when every other line in the prefecture is marked red with
"suspended.
I doubt it would stop unless the underground gets flooded.
Because of that, there are friends who complain about not being able to take a day off from their part-time jobs every time a typhoon hits.
But that's beside the point.
"What's wrong? Don't you want me to stay over? Is there something troubling you about it?"
"That's not it... You did talk to your family about this, right?"
"Of course. If I just left without saying anything on a day like this, they'd worry. It would be a hassle for you too."
"You're not even trying to hide your intentions."
So it really was a plan to stay over from the beginning.
While her staying over is an event I genuinely look forward to, I can't help but want to propose the theory of Tendou Tsukasa as a natural disaster...
More than anything, it would have been nice if she had at least given me a heads-up, right?
"It's dangerous to go back now, so it's fine to stay, but the room's not tidy since it's so sudden."
"That's okay, I'll clean up as a thank you."
That said, I couldn't just leave her standing at the entrance forever, so I took her bag and invited her into the room.
The weight of it definitely indicated that this was going to be a weekend stay.
By the way, when I handed her the bag and she said "thank you" with a slightly happy expression, it was really unfair.
Oh, and by the way, there's a reason I came to stay over.
My house is old, right?
When a typhoon hits, the noise can be really loud.
"Ah, I see."
The Tendou family's impressive mansion is indeed quite aged.
While I'm sure various renovations have been made since it was built, its soundproofing is nothing compared to a reinforced concrete building.
"So, I thought I could find comfort in Iori-kun's arms tonight."
"Tsukasa-san, have you been drinking since this morning?"
Why is she so high-spirited today?
I can't smell any alcohol, though.
"How rude! I'm sober. You know, on typhoon days, people tend to feel uplifted, right?"
"Uh-huh..."
Is she acting like an elementary school boy?
Well, I do get a bit excited about preparations, and I even stocked up on mineral water last night and taped the windows with protective tape, but thinking
"It's a typhoon, so let's stay over at my boyfriend's house!
" seems a bit too special of a case, doesn't it?
"And they say birth rates increase on days with power outages."
"Tsukasa-san, that's inappropriate."
Also, a city-wide blackout is quite a serious situation, so I hope she doesn't get her hopes up.
That's not good, you know.
"Oh, are we not going to have sex today? It's such a rare opportunity to stay over."
Isn't that a sly way to ask?
"I'm not really in the mood to increase the birth rate yet..."
"──'Not yet,' huh? Don't worry, I've brought condoms. I still want to be alone with Iori-kun for a long time."
I'm feeling a mix of happiness and embarrassment, and I don't know if I should respond or just stay silent, so my mental peace is definitely not okay.
"──Right."
"Yes, that's right."
While I could only manage a painful response, my beautiful girlfriend, like a human typhoon, continued to smile cheerfully.
"Okay, I'll be cooking, so if you could tidy up the room while I'm at it, that would be great."
"Sure, but now? Isn't it still a bit early for lunch?"
"No, I was thinking of making the croquettes for dinner ahead of time."
After all, boiling, frying, and sautéing takes quite a bit of time and effort, and if the power goes out while I'm frying, it could be dangerous.
"Why are we making fried food on a day like this?"
Perhaps sharing the same concern, Tendou tilted her head in confusion.
"Well, croquettes are a must on typhoon days, right?"
"I don't remember hearing that before. Where's that custom from?"
"Maybe it's just an internet trend?"
"Uh-huh..."
With a somewhat skeptical expression, Tendou fiddled with her smartphone before finishing her search and looking at me with an indescribable expression.
"What's that about?"
"I don't know what you saw, but it was explained just like that."
Someone must have made croquettes on a typhoon day, reported it online, and it spread through forums and social media, but if you break it down, it probably just feels like
"for some reason.
My brother said it's better than the unclear origins of Ehomaki, but is it a minority opinion...?
"Well, whatever. I'm going to borrow the vacuum cleaner."
"Ah, sure, go ahead."
Tendou still seemed somewhat unconvinced, but she decided to set it aside for now.
Honestly, I wouldn't know how to respond if she pressed further.
"Oh, by the way, I'm uploading something, so could you not touch the PC? I think it'll be done soon."
"That sounds like a really loud noise. Is it okay?"
"Yeah, it's fine."
With that, Tendou began tidying up the floor without any hesitation, while I, still not used to seeing her like this, felt a ticklish sensation and couldn't help but follow her with my eyes.
"Is there something I shouldn't touch?"
Noticing my suspicious behavior, Tendou looked up.
As she did, her hair fell in a way that seemed to make a sound.
"──Uh, it's nothing. So, please go ahead."
"Okay, leave it to me. Oh, close the door to keep the dust from coming in."
"Got it."
I thought I let out a somewhat reluctant voice as I closed the door separating the room from the kitchen, just as she had asked.
In the wind that blew, I could faintly smell Tendou's sweet scent.
"──Alright."
It's dangerous to be too cheerful while using sharp objects.
I shook my head to clear my thoughts and picked up a potato.
Once I started cooking, there was no room for any pink thoughts to creep in.
I washed the potato, peeled it, cut it into chunks, and soaked it in water before boiling it.
In the meantime, I sautéed minced onions with ground meat, seasoning them with salt and pepper.
After checking the potatoes with a skewer and finding them perfectly cooked, I transferred them to a bowl, mashed them, and mixed them with the sautéed ingredients.
"Mm, perfect."
As I tasted the mixture with a pinch, Tendou popped her head into the kitchen right at that moment.
"──Iori-kun, I've finished cleaning. Is there anything else I can help with?"
"Thanks. Could you taste this for me?"
As I offered her the bowl, Tendou lightly lifted her chin.
"My hands aren't washed yet, so can you feed me?"
"Uh, sure."
In a completely natural flow, she requested an "Ahh."
Well, I mean, I can manage this much, I thought as I made a mysterious excuse in my mind, and I gently tossed a small ball of the mixture into her slightly open mouth.
By the way, why does seeing someone eat evoke such inexplicable eroticism...?
"It's delicious."
"Glad to hear that."
Well, croquettes do take time, but the process itself is simple, and unless you make the coating too thick or over-fry them, it's hard to mess up.
"Next, we're going to coat them, right? I'll get ready right away, so just wait."
"Actually, I want to let them rest a bit first, so there's no need to rush."
I called out to Tendou, who was heading to the washroom instead of the kitchen sink.
"Is that so? Got it."
Her response, which was somewhat unfamiliar, felt very much like living together.
As I became aware of my relaxed expression, I tossed the pot and frying pan into the sink.
Hehe, I couldn't help but let out a voice of embarrassment, which I quickly suppressed by focusing on the grease stains.
"──By the way, Iori-kun, you don't wear an apron when you cook, do you?"
"Ah, no, I don't have one. Well, I don't really have anything that would get dirty in my regular clothes."
I'm now quite used to Tendou resting her head on my shoulder at such close proximity (though I won't say it doesn't make my heart race).
While taking a short break with my back against the bed, she intertwined her fingers with mine and playfully fiddled with them, sniffing my neck.
Mm...
But the smell can transfer, so wouldn't it be better to wear one?
You've been cooking for yourself more often lately, right?
"Well, that's true."
"By the way, has there been any change in your feelings?"
"Since summer vacation, there's been a girlfriend who keeps requesting home-cooked meals, I think."
"Not that."
"Uh, okay..."
"And your 'cute' girlfriend."
"Do you really need to add that?"
Isn't that a bit excessive in two ways?
But it's also true that there are reasons beyond just being asked.
Honestly, it's because Tsukasa-san says my cooking is delicious, so it's rewarding and fun.
I can't make anything too elaborate, though.
Since my dad and brother both cook at home, I never had any resistance to it, and while cooking for one can feel tedious, cooking for two can motivate me.
As I was thinking this, Tendou leaned against me like a cat, getting even closer.
"──Iori-kun really loves surprises, huh?"
"Isn't it more that Tsukasa-san enjoys being surprised?"
It seems my response pleased her, but considering how well she usually sees through me, I wonder if this was something she could have predicted.
"Iori-kun."
She rubbed her head against me like an affectionate animal and called my name in a sweet voice.
"Yes?"
When I turned to face her, I felt a soft sensation on my lips, followed by a warm, wet feeling that brushed against my front teeth.
This isn't the time to be doing that, is it?
The way she licked her lips after finishing was so primal that I was momentarily stunned, forgetting to scold her for being inappropriate.
I thought I was properly evaluating Tendou's beauty and various charms, but now everything seems to feel
"acceptable
Isn't the high standard set by Kamiyan's ex-girlfriend a threat that applies to me as well?
"What's wrong?"
"Uh, I was just wondering if I could properly recover if Tsukasa-san were to break up with me."
"Why are you suddenly worried about that?"
As soon as I voiced the anxiety that had popped into my head, Tendou's expression clouded over.
Her fingers, still intertwined with mine, tightened as if to admonish me.
"Hey, Iori-kun, I was trying to create a nice atmosphere just now, you know?"
"Ouch, ouch!"
Oh, she's genuinely angry.
"Well, I don't have any particular reason for it, but I was a bit startled too, and it just crossed my mind."
"You're able to feel anxious without any basis, huh... It's not like we're in an old drama or anything."
"I'm sorry."
"──Seriously, you're impossible."
With a hint of forgiveness in her demeanor, Tendou forcibly pushed my legs apart as I sat cross-legged, then settled in between them, leaning against me.
As usual, her sweet scent tickled my nostrils.
"By the way, Tsukasa-san, it's strange that you're trying to hold my hand right now."
"Huh? What? Isn't it normal for a boy to touch a girl's chest in situations like this?"
"You're being corrupted by the bad internet..."
Tendou, who had been trying to guide my hand to her chest, eventually compromised by letting me wrap my arms around her waist.
I felt relieved, but at the same time, I was surprised by how thin her waist was—thin, or rather, delicate.
"Speaking of the internet, what were you uploading earlier? A report?"
Not at all, I was uploading a recorded game video.
I was putting together material for the flag movie to post on our circle's channel.
The e-sports circle I belong to—essentially a PC gaming club,
"SW Gaming
"—mainly gathers through chat tools except for our monthly meetings.
As a result, we regularly post videos on our channel as a clear activity for the outside world.
"Flag movie?"
Yeah.
Um, how should I put it...
Basically, it's a gameplay video, but it's a compilation of highlights, like when you kill enemies.
"Is there one with you in it?"
"There's nothing that's just me, but there are a few scenes where I was featured."

I didn't think there were any embarrassing histories that would cause trouble, but having the PC open while half-heartedly watching a video made me a bit nervous, so I opened the video channel on my smartphone and played a randomly selected video.
"This one, the werewolf that appears in the second scene is my character."
However, having my handle name prominently displayed in the bottom right corner made it a bit embarrassing to show to others.
Why did I choose such a cringy name...?
While I was lost in thought, the video showed the werewolf, barely alive, slashing at three enemies with its claws.
"...I don't really get what's impressive about this."
"It's hard to explain again, but just think of it as a compilation of cool scenes for gamers."
"I see. So, this game is sometimes the reason why Iori-kun's reactions are slow at night, right?"
"──Uh-huh."
I wasn't expecting her to react with "Wow, that's amazing!" or anything, but this was way off the mark. Too unexpected!
And it's not like I'm neglecting Tendou; it's just that I get messages when I'm in the middle of gaming... (shaky voice).
"I'm not angry or anything, but... if you're curious, should I give Iori-kun a chance to make me happy?"
"I don't have that much saved up..."
"Don't try to solve it with money. That's not what I meant—don't you notice anything about me?"
Isn't that more of an instant-death trap where if I don't get it right, she'll be in a bad mood?
It's one thing if I were a popular guy, but my romantic skills are still terrible!
"You can look at me and touch me as much as you want."
"Even if you say that..."
I can only see the top of her bright-colored head in front of me.
As I was thinking this, Tendou turned around, knelt, and allowed my hands to rest on her slender waist while placing her hands on my shoulders, looking down at me directly.
"I'll give you unlimited time as a service."
"Yay!"
"Your heart's not in it...!"
Well, you see...
If I move my hands up, it would look like I'm lifting a child, but the way she smiles down at me is not cute at all; it's actually quite intimidating and powerful.
As I thought about how stunning her face is, I took on the challenge.
"Your hair..."
"I haven't cut it."
"Your weight..."
"I haven't lost any. By the way, I think that's something Iori-kun would be happy about."
"Uh-huh..."
At this point, I'm completely stuck...
And I get shot down before I can finish my thoughts, making it even harder to answer.
"...Can't you think of anything else?"
Please stop asking me that with such a genuinely curious expression.
Is my boyfriend's score too low? That's what I'm starting to think. It is true, though.
"My waist has gotten thinner?"
"That's close, but no."
"Close? Uh, then maybe my butt has gotten smaller...?"
"That's not it, but would Iori-kun prefer it smaller?"
"That's a tough question to answer. I don't have any complaints about Tsukasa-san's figure."
"That's true."
Ugh, she's strong.
But what else could there be?
I don't think my scent has changed, and I don't really understand what would make me happy.
Could it be that her face has gotten prettier? (confused)
"I give up; I don't know."
I cautiously met her gaze and raised the white flag.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/QksK287.jpeg
Tendou only smiled faintly at my reaction.
"The correct answer is that my bra size has gone up by one."
"What am I supposed to say to that?"
So, does that mean her chest has gotten bigger...? Should I just say that?
And now Tendou thinks I would be happy if her chest got bigger.
I can't say I'm offended, but it leaves me with a strange feeling...
"Well, even so, I still lose to Mahiro."
"Eh?"
And when another girl's name suddenly came up while we were alone, I couldn't help but ponder its implications.
After all, if I were to say something, I would definitely get shot down.
"──I don't think there's anything about Tsukasa-san that loses to Kuzunoha."
Oh, she made a rare expression there.
With a look of surprise that seemed to fit the description of "dazed," Tendou blinked rapidly.
"Mahiro's chest is an H cup, you know."
"That's not what I meant..."
I'm sure her size is indeed larger when compared, and that's impressive!
But before I could even awkwardly explain myself, Tendou, having understood my intent, smiled brightly, genuinely happy.
"──But if Iori-kun says that, then I'm okay with it."
"Yeah."
I think Kuzunoha is a bit off her rocker (iron will), but she's still one of Tendou's rare friends.
So even if she gives off a somewhat unsettling vibe, I don't think I can easily change our relationship.
And because of that, I think it complicates her feelings of guilt towards me.
So, I thought that for someone important, someone I want to cherish, I shouldn't hold back my words, even if it feels embarrassing.
"What I'm really concerned about is Tsukasa-san."
"──Yeah, thank you. I'm sorry for being so troublesome."
With Tendou's slightly demure response, I felt even more convinced that this was the right thing to do.
The shame of trying to look cool is not important at all.
My heart feels like it's completely undamaged.
"Honestly, I think I can be a bit of a hassle too."
"That's true."
"Isn't that terrible?"
"That's fine; I like you just the way you are."
"Is that so...?"
"──Hehe."
I tried to maintain a poker face, but I wish she wouldn't hit me with such an immediate attack.
As expected, my inner turmoil was clearly visible, and she was giggling at me.
But as long as Tendou is having fun, that's what matters! (desperate)
"Also, I don't really have a strong preference for breast size, to begin with."
"Is that so?"
With her usual demeanor returning, Tendou wrapped her hand around the back of my head.
If she hugs me like this, my face would end up buried in her chest.
And I knew from experience that Tendou was the kind of girl who would take things further in situations like this.
"But if my chest has gotten bigger, wouldn't that make you happy?"
"I don't even know how to respond to that..."
"Then how about you check thoroughly from now on?"
"──Physically?"
After some hesitation, my strange response made Tendou laugh again.
"Yes, physically."
"But it's still daytime..."
"It's dark outside, so it's practically night."
"That's quite a logic."
So, does that mean that on cloudy days, Tendou considers it daytime even during the night?
If we keep having bad weather during our stay, I might end up feeling drained and die from it.
"What? Are you not okay with it?"
"That's not it, but..."
"But, that's enough."
Oh, there's no escaping now, is there?
In the next moment, I found myself embraced by Tendou's soft, sweet-smelling chest, and I resigned myself.
──In the end, it was well into the afternoon, when the typhoon was vigorously shaking the shutters, that we finally got around to frying the croquettes.
